knowledge.panchanga.title: Panchanga
knowledge.panchanga.body: Panchanga brings together Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana. Ghadi anchors these values to the local sunrise and exposes the exact engine output behind each one.
knowledge.tithi.title: Tithi
knowledge.tithi.summary: A lunar day measured by the Sun-Moon angle.
knowledge.tithi.body: One Tithi spans 12 degrees of lunar elongation. The Drik engine determines the Tithi at local sunrise and interpolates its ending instant.
knowledge.nakshatra.title: Nakshatra
knowledge.nakshatra.summary: The Moon's passage through 27 stellar sectors.
knowledge.nakshatra.body: Each Nakshatra covers a segment of the sidereal ecliptic and is divided into four Padas. Ghadi uses the configured Nakshatra system from the engine.
knowledge.yoga.title: Yoga
knowledge.yoga.summary: A division based on the combined sidereal longitudes.
knowledge.yoga.body: The Sun and Moon longitudes are added and divided into 27 equal Yogas. The resulting sunrise Yoga and ending time come directly from panchanga.py.
knowledge.karana.title: Karana
knowledge.karana.body: A Karana spans six degrees of lunar elongation. Four fixed and seven repeating Karanas organize the lunar day.
knowledge.ayanamsha.title: Ayanamsha
knowledge.ayanamsha.body: Ayanamsha defines the relationship between tropical and sidereal longitude. Ghadi exposes the selected Swiss Ephemeris mode in every cosmic response.
knowledge.muhurta.title: Muhurta
knowledge.muhurta.summary: A time window selected for a purpose.
knowledge.muhurta.body: Ghadi's sunrise-anchored day record already contains Rahu Kalam, Durmuhurta, Varjyam, and Pratah Sandhya. Future Muhurta rules should consume those same intervals.
